title: UI Tweaks
description: Optional UI customization patches for ChatGPT Community.

catalogSubfeatures.title: Dock icon
catalogSubfeatures.description: Expose the Dock icon selector and synchronize the selected icon with Linux windows, tray and supported launchers.

catalogSubfeatures.title: Extended UI font size
catalogSubfeatures.description: Raise the UI font-size maximum to a configurable value.

catalogSubfeatures.title: Custom font input
catalogSubfeatures.description: Switch between installed fonts and a manually entered CSS font-family stack.

catalogSubfeatures.title: Suggested prompts
catalogSubfeatures.description: Expose Suggested Prompts in settings and enable project-aware cards on Home.

catalogSubfeatures.title: Expanded model picker
catalogSubfeatures.description: Open the advanced picker by default and show models inline with their supported reasoning efforts.

catalogSubfeatures.title: English reasoning effort labels
catalogSubfeatures.description: Keep reasoning effort names in English in the Simplified Chinese interface.

catalogSubfeatures.title: Selection: More details
catalogSubfeatures.description: Restore the selected-text More details action that asks Quick Chat to explain the selection.

catalogSubfeatures.title: Annotation submit shortcut
catalogSubfeatures.description: Send the active selected-text annotation with Ctrl+Enter without the regular composer intercepting it.

catalogSubfeatures.title: Sidebar project names
catalogSubfeatures.description: Apply a configurable style to project names in the sidebar.
